messages:
Evan (Prod Marketing): Hey team — small but urgent design pack for the "Serve Better" launch. Need assets for paid/social + SDRs + sales. Minimal scope: hero tile (1200x628, light/dark), 3 social tiles (1080x1080) A/B copy, sales 1-pager (A4 + web PDF), and a benchmark mini-infographic PNG for slide decks. Due: next Tue EOD.
Priya (Design Lead): Got it. Prioritize hero + infographic. Quick questions: do we want motion for hero (GIF) or static only? Also confirm headline voice: more technical or benefit-first?
Noah (Growth Ops): Hero GIF would be great for paid, but if time is tight static works. Voice: variant A technical ("Latency-optimized inference, 1/3 token cost"), variant B benefit ("Ship features faster, pay less").
Marta (Localization): Note: we'll need separate Figma pages for EN/FR/DE and a CSV with copy keys. Plan for +25% expansion for DE. Also please include context notes for translators.
Priya (Design Lead): Will do. Packaging rules: use primary palette for hero, avoid red/green pairs for charts (colorblind-safe), logo lockup lower-left, 16px min copy when scaled to 1080x1080. Will add safe zones.
Evan (Prod Marketing): Also include alt-text drafts (one sentence each) and 1-line social captions for X + LinkedIn. UTM scheme: campaign=serve-better-2026; source=paid_social|email; medium=paid|email; content=heroA|heroB. Add example mapping in handoff.
Noah (Growth Ops): For lead routing, map utm_source=paid_social -> Paid Ads queue, utm_source=email -> Nurture queue. Put that in the SDR slide notes.
Priya (Design Lead): File naming convention? Suggest: `launch/servebetter/2026/<asset>-<variant>-<size>-v1.<ext>` e.g. `launch/servebetter/2026/hero-technical-1200x628-v1.gif`
Evan (Prod Marketing): That naming works. Include PNG + GIF + PDF exports plus SVG for logo. Also include a handoff checklist PDF with: Figma link, approved exports, filenames, copy table (CSV), alt-text, localization pages, legal notes.
LegalBot: Quick legal flags: 1) If partner logos are present on 1-pager, we need written proof of permission. 2) Add footer: "© 2026 Redwood Inference. All rights reserved." 3) Any benchmark claims must have source annotation. Please add a small footnote area on 1-pager.
Marta (Localization): Also request plain-text copy file (UTF-8 CSV) for translators with keys and context.
Priya (Design Lead): Timeline: hero comps by Wed 10am PT, infographic + 1-pager draft by Thu noon, first exports by Fri, final handoff + localization files by Tue EOD.
Noah (Growth Ops): Can we get short copy QA review Friday AM? I'll batch review captions and UTMs.
Evan (Prod Marketing): Yes — schedule a 20-min sync Fri AM for quick copy + legal checks.
Priya (Design Lead): Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/servebetter/rl-inference-launchpack — access: anyone-with-link (view). I'll add pages per locale and a "copy only" page.
Marta (Localization): Thanks — will add translator comments to the DE page about +25% expansion and preferred date formats.
LegalBot: Adding myself to Figma comments. Please tag me before final export.
Priya (Design Lead): Noted. I'll include an export manifest JSON/CSV inside the handoff (list of filenames + checksums) and a single-slide printable handoff checklist for ops.
Evan (Prod Marketing): Great. Please @marketing when hero GIF/PNG is uploaded so paid team can queue promos.
Priya (Design Lead): Will do. :white_check_mark:
